description: Source code for file packing and unpacking functions, including pack_files, unpack_files, and dump_pack_hdr, with related data structures and file handling logic.

methods.name: pack_files
methods.description: Creates a packed header structure by reading multiple files, storing their metadata, and concatenating their contents.

methods.name: unpack_files
methods.description: Extracts files from a packed header structure, writing their contents to disk.

methods.name: dump_pack_hdr
methods.description: Outputs the details of a pack header structure for debugging or inspection.
